evidence.observation: Reboiler heater temperature ~389.5 °C, far above the 72.7 °C vessel temperature, and drifting upward ~6 °C since k=12 (389.7 -> 395.4) with no corresponding rise in T703 or column temperatures
Reboiler vessel temperature nearly flat 72.66 -> 73.05 °C despite rising heater power/temperature
Distillate flow erratic and near zero (0.004-0.26), reflux FT704 also noisy 0.17-0.78; no steady product take-off
Column pressure drop only ~0.6-0.8 mbar, indicating very low vapour traffic/no established boil-up
Top/section temperatures pinned at ~63.3 °C with no profile development over 20 min
